udt_struct_v0.doc: One entry of a blast batch.
udt_struct_v0.name: BlastEntry

function_v0.doc:
Fire one batch of deliveries and holds. Source auth only.

The batch is validated as a whole before anything moves: every
amount positive, and the contract balance must cover the
existing total_pending plus the full batch sum. Per entry:
Hold credits pending exactly as credit() does. Deliver tries
the token transfer without reverting on failure \xe2\x80\x94 success
emits a delivered event; failure credits the full amount as
pending and emits a fallback event, so an amount is never lost
and never blocks the rest of the batch.
function_v0.name: blast

function_v0.doc:
Claim the caller's full pending mark. The entry is removed and
the amount transferred via the token contract. If the recipient
holds no trustline the token transfer fails and the whole call
reverts, leaving the entry untouched.
function_v0.name: claim

function_v0.doc:
Add pending marks. Source auth only. Every amount must be
positive, and the contract's token balance must cover the
existing total plus everything being added \xe2\x80\x94 crediting beyond
holdings is impossible.
function_v0.name: credit

function_v0.doc: Permissionless lifetime extension for named entries that exist.
function_v0.name: extend

function_v0.doc: Public read: pending stroops for an address, 0 when none.
function_v0.name: pending

function_v0.doc:
Replace this contract's code. Two keys must speak: the
admin's ordinary authorization, AND a WOTS+ one-time signature
(the post-quantum guard) over exactly this upgrade \xe2\x80\x94 this
contract, the new code hash, the next key's commitment, and
the current upgrade sequence number. The presented public key
must hash to the stored commitment. On success the commitment
rotates to `next_pq_root` and the sequence advances, so the
signature just used can never authorize anything again; the
private key behind a commitment signs exactly one upgrade in
its life, and its successor is generated fresh by the signer.
Any storage reshaping belongs to a migrate function in the NEW
version's code, per the documented upgrade pattern.
function_v0.name: upgrade

function_v0.doc: Public read: exact sum of all pending entries.
function_v0.name: total_pending

function_v0.doc: Public read (v3): the current WOTS+ commitment guarding the\nupgrade door, and the number of completed upgrades.
function_v0.name: upgrade_state
